title: An explicit enforcement policy must survive migrate
description: an explicit enforcement policy must survive migrate
no_spec_change_rationale: config_to_toml omitted enforcement when the value was Warn with the comment default-omit, but the default moved to Strict, so migrate dropped an explicit warn and the project silently became gating
acceptance_criteria: a project with an explicit enforcement value has the same effective policy before and after migrate, demonstrated by check exiting identically on a tree with a validation error; the migrated config states the enforcement explicitly rather than relying on whichever default the binary carries; a project that never set enforcement is unaffected; the documented default matches the code
